sources.title: SwingTrace AI Pro — AI Golf Swing Analyser | Track Your Progress
sources.snippet: AI maps your kinematic sequence SwingTrace automatically detects your P2-P7 swing positions using pose estimation, then processes every frame: tracking hip rotation, shoulder coil, arm path, and club trajectory against biomechanical baselines. In your browser.

sources.title: SwingTrace
sources.snippet: Clear boundaries for V1 SwingTrace separates local practice review from account, subscription, support, and enabled sharing flows.

sources.title: GitHub - nishsm/swingtrace: Golf club shaft, head and hands detection ...
sources.snippet: Face blurred for privacy. SwingTrace finds the club shaft, club head and hands in every frame and rebuilds the club-head path through the whole swing, including the top of the backswing and impact, where the head turns into a blur and normal detectors lose it.

sources.snippet: SwingTrace PRO is a golf improvement app powered by V-core AI, which analyzes your swing video and delivers pro-coach quality feedback. Simply record or select a video of your swing.
